english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone deliberately threatens another person.
Use this for the menace or threat itself, rather than the immediate feeling of fear it causes.

examples.english: If you don’t pay me back, I’ll threaten to make the photos public.
examples.traditional: 你再唔還錢，我就威脅你公開啲相。
examples.jyutping: nei5 zoi3 m4 waan4 cin2 ngo5 zau6 wai1 hip3 nei5 gung1 hoi1 di1 soeng2

examples.english: His threat to retaliate was meant to terrify me.
examples.traditional: 佢話要報復，呢個係對我嘅威脅。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 bou3 fuk6 ni1 go3 hai6 deoi3 ngo5 ge3 wai1 hip3
